title: THE MOTHERSHIP
heading: MAW'S
MOTHERSHIP
intro: SPIKE THE SHINE DRIVE AND DRAIN THE COW TUBES.
ending: "TELL YER MAW SHE CAN KEEP THE BUS."

stations.label: SPIKE THE DRIVE WITH SHINE
stations.message: DRIVE SPIKED. 180 PROOF. THE BULKHEADS ARE LOOSE.

stations.label: DRAIN THE COW TUBES
stations.message: TUBES DRAINED. THE COWS ARE MAD AND THE BRIDGE IS OPEN.

stations.label: OPEN THE CORE IRIS
stations.message: THE IRIS IS OPEN. SOMETHING BIG IN THE CORE JUST WOKE UP.

stations.label: TUG THE LAWN ELF'S HAT
stations.message: THE ELF'S HAT IS A LEVER. OF COURSE IT IS.

notes: WHO KEEPS PLAYING THE SAME SONG. -THE CREW
1. PROBE THE COWS. 2. FIND WHO DONE IT TO MY BOY. 3. PIE.
DAY 9 OVER HICKSTON. MAW WON'T GO HOME TILL SHE GETS HER REVENGE AND HER DISH BACK.

lines: PA: HOOMAN LOOSE ON DECK FOUR.
VOICE: WHICH ONE IS THE HOOMAN?
PA: WHO PUT DIESEL IN THE DRIVE?
MAW: WHERE'S MY BOY'S TIN STAR?

do.message: THE RING DECK. IT GOES ALL THE WAY ROUND.
THE PROBE LAB. KEEP YER BACK TO THE WALL.
